title: Map bookkeeping: one settled line per ticket, out of scope never settled, map done from every path
summary: Makes the map tell the PRD writer the truth: one settled line per ticket, out-of-scope tickets never settled, updateMap reports map done, safer two-laptop writes and repeatable create and merge. Not merged: the criterion that the map screen starts the PRD writer from updateMap needs a person's decision, because no screen control removes fog.
friction: The machine-wide gate lock /c/wt/with-gate-lock.sh that CLAUDE.md requires is not in the repository and did not exist on this laptop, so both full gates ran without it; a second laptop or fresh setup always hits this.
The pinned Node 24.22.2 was not installed on this laptop after the pin was raised, which stopped the first preflight until a person installed it.
lessons_learned: A story filed agent-ready can ask for a screen behaviour with no control in the prototype or PRD: issue #189's fourth criterion did, and it surfaced only at review after a full build. Check that every screen clause has a prototype control when filing.

deferred.what: Any mention of a ticket under Out of scope counts as closed as out of scope: with the line 'Mobile app: ruled out by the decision on #2', closing decided ticket 2 writes no settled line, so its decision is missing from the map, and reopening ticket 2 deletes the Mobile app line.
deferred.why: Telling a mention from a closing line needs a format decision shared with the skills, which write free text.

deferred.what: A map write from another laptop based on an older read that lands after this laptop's read-back still loses a settled line, and neither side notices; the repair, closing the ticket again, has no control on an already closed ticket short of reopening it.
deferred.why: Closing it for good needs a real lock (a git ref as a mutex), with stale locks and an extra ref in every project; the issue allows re-read and retry.
